muc_dich: Cai tien ngoai yeu cau de cuong: giam do tre cho ngu canh (muc 1.2, 4.5) bang cach dat doan mat muon hon trong cua so khi trien khai.
quy_tac_chon_muc_cho: Chi dung VALIDATION (S11, S12). Muc cho khuyen nghi la muc cho ngan nhat ma (1) MAE validation macro cua mo hinh chinh khong vuot qua 5% so voi muc cho 3 giay (a = 192) va (2) mo hinh van tot hon lap chu ky tren validation o muc do. Test (S13-S15) chi dung de bao cao muc da chon.
dieu_kien_phan_B: Neu o cac muc cho duoi 1 giay (a = 352, 384, ngoai vung huan luyen) MAE validation cua mo hinh chinh vuot qua nguong 5% thi moi can nhac huan luyen them mot bien the duoc huan luyen voi vi tri mat na rong hon; bien the do (neu co) cung chi chon bang validation va bao cao rieng.
